answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 45846 Country: India Title: about breaking wudhu during salat Question: (1) Is it necessary to break salah and do wudhu, if gas releases during salah? (2) Is it allowed to detain gas during salah and complete the salah? Answer ID: 45846 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 943/745/B=1434) (1) Yes, it is necessary to break the salah and perform wudhu. He should go back putting his hand on his nose and then join the salah in the same rukn in which wudhu was broken or offer salah again. (2) It is makrooh tahrimi to stop it to an extent that one feels discomfort and the khushu and khuzu of salah is gone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
